## GomDE adapted to the topics
```{r}
library(MCMCpack)
library(MASS)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(fastTopics)
library(limma)
library(clue)

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Distance and error utilities
# ----------------------------------------------------------
compute_distance_matrix <- function(W_true, W_est) {
  K <- nrow(W_true)
  D <- matrix(NA_real_, K, K)
  for (k in 1:K) {
    for (j in 1:K) {
      v1 <- W_true[k, ]
      v2 <- W_est[j, ]
      cos_sim <- sum(v1*v2) /
        (sqrt(sum(v1^2)*sum(v2^2)) + 1e-20)
      D[k,j] <- 1 - cos_sim
    }
  }
  D
}

compute_topic_error <- function(W_true, W_est) {
  diffs <- sqrt(rowSums((W_true - W_est)^2))
  list(mean_error = mean(diffs),
       max_error  = max(diffs))
}

compute_similarity_matrix <- function(W_true) {
  K <- nrow(W_true)
  S <- matrix(NA_real_, K, K)
  for (i in 1:K)
    for (j in 1:K) {
      v1 <- W_true[i,];  
      v2 <- W_true[j,]
      S[i,j] <- sum(v1*v2) / 
        (sqrt(sum(v1^2))*sqrt(sum(v2^2)) + 1e-20)
    }
  S
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Simulation settings
# ----------------------------------------------------------
K_values <- c(6,9)
nsim <- 20

all_results_BH <- list()
all_results_BY <- list()
row_BH <- 1
row_BY <- 1

# ⭐ NEW: storage for W_est
all_W <- list()
w_row <- 1

set.seed(1005)

# ==========================================================
#                     MAIN LOOP
# ==========================================================
for (K in K_values) {

  cat("\n============================\n")
  cat("Running K =", K, "\n")
  cat("============================\n")

  for (sim in 1:nsim) {

    # ----------------------
    # Generate simulation
    # ----------------------
    N <- 1000; G <- 500
    beta_strength <- 2
    set.seed(100 + sim)

    X <- rbinom(N, 1, 0.5)

    mu_k <- rnorm(K, 0, 1)
    diff_k <- rep(FALSE, K)
    diff_idx <- sample(1:K, 2)
    diff_k[diff_idx] <- TRUE
    beta_k <- ifelse(diff_k, rnorm(K, beta_strength, 0.5), 0)

    eta <- sapply(1:K, function(k) rnorm(N, mu_k[k] + X*beta_k[k], 1))
    E <- exp(eta)

    T_mat <- matrix(rlnorm(K*G, 0, 1), K, G)
    W_true <- t(apply(T_mat, 1, function(a) rdirichlet(1, a)))

    l_n <- runif(N, 1000, 10000)
    mean_ng <- (E %*% W_true) * l_n
    Y_ng <- matrix(rpois(N*G, as.vector(mean_ng)), N, G)

    # ----------------------
    # fastTopics
    # ----------------------
    fit <- fit_poisson_nmf(Y_ng, k = K, numiter = 200, verbose = "none")
    fit_multinom <- poisson2multinom(fit)
    beta_hat <- fit_multinom$F

    # ----------------------
    # Topic alignment
    # ----------------------
    D <- compute_distance_matrix(W_true, t(beta_hat))
    assignment <- solve_LSAP(D)
    beta_hat <- beta_hat[, assignment]
    W_est_aligned <- t(beta_hat)

    err <- compute_topic_error(W_true, W_est_aligned)

    # --------------------------------------------------
    # Similarity of null to true topics
    # --------------------------------------------------
    S <- compute_similarity_matrix(W_true)

    true_topics <- which(diff_k)
    null_topics <- which(!diff_k)

    max_sim_null <- sapply(null_topics, function(k)
      max(S[k, true_topics])
    )

    mean_null_sim  <- mean(max_sim_null)
    max_null_sim   <- max(max_sim_null)
    median_null_sim <- median(max_sim_null)

    # ----------------------
    # Per-cell GLM → W_est
    # ----------------------
    W_est <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow=N, ncol=K)

    for (ii in 1:N) {
      y_i <- Y_ng[ii, ]
      X_i <- l_n[ii] * beta_hat

      df_i <- data.frame(y=y_i, X_i)
      colnames(df_i) <- c("y", paste0("B",1:K))

      form_i <- as.formula(
        paste("y ~", paste(colnames(df_i)[-1], collapse=" + "), "- 1")
      )

      fit_i <- try(
        glm(form_i, data=df_i, family=poisson(link="identity"),
            start=rep(mean(y_i)/K, K)),
        silent = TRUE
      )

      coef_i <- if (inherits(fit_i, "try-error")) rep(0, K) else coef(fit_i)
      W_est[ii, ] <- pmax(coef_i, 0)
    }

    # ⭐⭐⭐ NEW: STORE W_est ⭐⭐⭐
    all_W[[w_row]] <- list(
      K        = K,
      sim      = sim,
      W_est    = W_est,
      W_true   = W_true,
      diff_k   = diff_k,
      X        = X,
      l_n      = l_n
    )
    w_row <- w_row + 1
    # ----------------------------------------------------

    # ----------------------
    # LIMMA on log W_est
    # ----------------------
    W_log <- log(W_est + 1e-8)
    fitL <- lmFit(t(W_log), model.matrix(~ X))
    fitL <- eBayes(fitL)
    tt   <- topTable(fitL, coef = 2, number = Inf, sort.by="none")
    pvals <- tt$P.Value

    # ======================
    #     (1) BH
    # ======================
    
    detected_BH <- p.adjust(pvals, "BH") < 0.05
    
    TP_BH <- sum(detected_BH & diff_k)
    FP_BH <- sum(detected_BH & !diff_k)
    Power_BH <- TP_BH / sum(diff_k)
    FDP_BH   <- ifelse(sum(detected_BH)==0, 0, FP_BH / sum(detected_BH))
    
    # NEW: list detected topics
    detected_topics_BH <- if (any(detected_BH)) {
      paste(which(detected_BH), collapse = ",")
    } else {
      "none"
    }
    
    all_results_BH[[row_BH]] <- data.frame(
      Adjust = "BH",
      K = K,
      sim = sim,
      TP = TP_BH,
      FP = FP_BH,
      Power = Power_BH,
      FDP   = FDP_BH,
      mean_err = err$mean_error,
      max_err  = err$max_error,
      mean_null_sim = mean_null_sim,
      max_null_sim = max_null_sim,
      median_null_sim = median_null_sim,
      detected_topics = detected_topics_BH   ## NEW
    )
    row_BH <- row_BH + 1

    # detected_BH <- p.adjust(pvals, "BH") < 0.05
    # 
    # TP_BH <- sum(detected_BH & diff_k)
    # FP_BH <- sum(detected_BH & !diff_k)
    # Power_BH <- TP_BH / sum(diff_k)
    # FDP_BH   <- ifelse(sum(detected_BH)==0, 0, FP_BH / sum(detected_BH))
    # 
    # all_results_BH[[row_BH]] <- data.frame(
    #   Adjust = "BH",
    #   K = K,
    #   sim = sim,
    #   TP = TP_BH,
    #   FP = FP_BH,
    #   Power = Power_BH,
    #   FDP   = FDP_BH,
    #   mean_err = err$mean_error,
    #   max_err  = err$max_error,
    #   mean_null_sim = mean_null_sim,
    #   max_null_sim = max_null_sim,
    #   median_null_sim = median_null_sim
    # )
    # row_BH <- row_BH + 1

    # ======================
    #     (2) BY
    # ======================
    
    detected_BY <- p.adjust(pvals, "BY") < 0.05
    
    TP_BY <- sum(detected_BY & diff_k)
    FP_BY <- sum(detected_BY & !diff_k)
    Power_BY <- TP_BY / sum(diff_k)
    FDP_BY   <- ifelse(sum(detected_BY)==0, 0, FP_BY / sum(detected_BY))
    
    # NEW: detected topics list
    detected_topics_BY <- if (any(detected_BY)) {
      paste(which(detected_BY), collapse = ",")
    } else {
      "none"
    }
    
    all_results_BY[[row_BY]] <- data.frame(
      Adjust = "BY",
      K = K,
      sim = sim,
      TP = TP_BY,
      FP = FP_BY,
      Power = Power_BY,
      FDP   = FDP_BY,
      mean_err = err$mean_error,
      max_err  = err$max_error,
      mean_null_sim = mean_null_sim,
      max_null_sim = max_null_sim,
      median_null_sim = median_null_sim,
      detected_topics = detected_topics_BY   ## NEW
    )
    row_BY <- row_BY + 1

    # detected_BY <- p.adjust(pvals, "BY") < 0.05
    # 
    # TP_BY <- sum(detected_BY & diff_k)
    # FP_BY <- sum(detected_BY & !diff_k)
    # Power_BY <- TP_BY / sum(diff_k)
    # FDP_BY   <- ifelse(sum(detected_BY)==0, 0, FP_BY / sum(detected_BY))
    # 
    # all_results_BY[[row_BY]] <- data.frame(
    #   Adjust = "BY",
    #   K = K,
    #   sim = sim,
    #   TP = TP_BY,
    #   FP = FP_BY,
    #   Power = Power_BY,
    #   FDP   = FDP_BY,
    #   mean_err = err$mean_error,
    #   max_err  = err$max_error,
    #   mean_null_sim = mean_null_sim,
    #   max_null_sim = max_null_sim,
    #   median_null_sim = median_null_sim
    # )
    # row_BY <- row_BY + 1
  }
}

# -------------------------------
# Final BH / BY results
# -------------------------------
output_BH <- do.call(rbind, all_results_BH)
output_BY <- do.call(rbind, all_results_BY)
```

```{r}
for (i in seq_along(all_W)) {

  K        <- all_W[[i]]$K
  sim      <- all_W[[i]]$sim
  W_est    <- all_W[[i]]$W_est
  X        <- all_W[[i]]$X
  diff_k   <- all_W[[i]]$diff_k

  # -----------------------------
  # Build W_long (your code)
  # -----------------------------
  W_df <- as.data.frame(W_est)
  colnames(W_df) <- paste0("Topic", 1:K)

  W_df$Condition <- factor(X, labels = c("Control", "Treatment"))

  W_long <- W_df %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = starts_with("Topic"),
      names_to = "Topic",
      values_to = "Activity"
    )

  # -----------------------------
  # Plot 1
  # -----------------------------
  # p1 <- ggplot(W_long, aes(x = Topic, y = Activity, fill = Condition)) +

  #     y = "Estimated activity",
  #     x = "Topic"
  #   )
  # print(p1)

  # -----------------------------
  # Truth annotation
  # -----------------------------
  true_topics <- paste0("Topic", which(diff_k))
  W_long$Truth <- ifelse(W_long$Topic %in% true_topics,
                         "True DE", "Null")

  # -----------------------------
  # Plot 2
  # -----------------------------
  p2 <- ggplot(W_long, aes(x = Topic, y = Activity, fill = Condition)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.2) +
    facet_wrap(~ Truth, scales = "free_x") +
    scale_y_log10() +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
      title = paste("Estimated W_est with truth annotation — K =", K, "sim =", sim),
      y = "Estimated activity",
      x = "Topic"
    )
  print(p2)

  # (optional: save)
  # ggsave(paste0("plot1_K", K, "_sim", sim, ".png"), p1, width=7, height=5)
  # ggsave(paste0("plot2_K", K, "_sim", sim, ".png"), p2, width=7, height=5)
}
```

## FDP >0.05
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# bad runs: FDP > 0.05
bad_runs <- output_BH %>% filter(FDP > 0.05)

for (i in seq_along(all_W)) {

  K      <- all_W[[i]]$K
  sim    <- all_W[[i]]$sim

  # ---- skip if this (K, sim) is not a bad run ----
  if (!( (K %in% bad_runs$K) & (sim %in% bad_runs$sim[bad_runs$K == K]) )) {
    next
  }

  W_est  <- all_W[[i]]$W_est
  X      <- all_W[[i]]$X
  diff_k <- all_W[[i]]$diff_k

  # -----------------------------
  # Build W_long 
  # -----------------------------
  W_df <- as.data.frame(W_est)
  colnames(W_df) <- paste0("Topic", 1:K)
  W_df$Condition <- factor(X, labels = c("Control", "Treatment"))

  W_long <- W_df %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = starts_with("Topic"),
      names_to = "Topic",
      values_to = "Activity"
    )

  # -----------------------------
  # Truth annotation
  # -----------------------------
  true_topics <- paste0("Topic", which(diff_k))
  W_long$Truth <- ifelse(W_long$Topic %in% true_topics, "True DE", "Null")

  # -----------------------------
  # Plot ONLY bad FDP cases
  # -----------------------------
  p2 <- ggplot(W_long, aes(x = Topic, y = Activity, fill = Condition)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.2) +
    facet_wrap(~ Truth, scales = "free_x") +
    scale_y_log10() +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
      title = paste("High-FDP Case — K =", K, "sim =", sim, "(FDP > 0.05)"),
      y = "Estimated activity",
      x = "Topic"
    )

  print(p2)
}
```
